contentBlocks.text: Appealing a Decline Due to NSFAS Funding

Students who previously received National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) funding are often declined for SASSA grants. If your studies are finished or you no longer receive NSFAS, you need to appeal this decision.

steps.title: Request NSFAS letter
steps.description: Request a NSFAS Cancellation Letter or Completion Letter from NSFAS via the myNSFAS portal.

steps.title: Log into the appeal portal
steps.description: Visit the ITSAA appeal portal at srd.dsd.gov.za.

steps.title: Submit your appeal
steps.description: State that you are no longer an active student and receive no educational allowances. Upload your NSFAS letter as proof.

contentBlocks.title: Timeline
contentBlocks.text: Must be filed within 90 days. NSFAS letters can be requested via the myNSFAS portal.

faqs.question: Can active students get SASSA grants?
faqs.answer: No, active tertiary students receiving NSFAS are not eligible for social grants as their living costs are already subsidised by the state.

faqs.question: How do I get a NSFAS cancellation letter?
faqs.answer: Log into your myNSFAS account and request a 'Proof of Non-Funding' or 'Cancellation Letter' from the documents section.
